whatItDoes:
Pursuant to the authority granted by C.R.S. §1-4-1404,
shall the term limits for the District Attorney of the 12th
Judicial District established in Article XVIII § 11(1) of
the Colorado Constitution be eliminated, allowing the
District Attorney of the 12th Judicial District to serve an
indefinite number of terms?
